--@testPoint 锁定列，创建for update游标

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE pro_YDBRD_19151_671(C INT) IS
CURSOR cur1(N1 INT) is  SELECT * FROM tb_YDBRD_19151_671 a right join tb_YDBRD_19151_671_add b  ON 1=1 and a.col_int>=N1 for update of a.col_int nowait order by 1;
BEGIN
 for rec in cur1(c) loop
   null;
  END LOOP;
END;
/
exec pro_YDBRD_19151_671(2);
